---
title: "SGPstateData"
subtitle: "State assessment program meta-data"
toc: true
---

## Description

`SGPstateData` is an environment holding one entry per assessment program (a state, a consortium, or an organization), keyed by an abbreviation such as `"GA"` or `"WIDA"`. The SGP package reads it to find achievement level cutscores, the knots and boundaries for the B-spline fits, assessment names and labels for reports, and the rules for the order of prior scores. It is built from the source files in this repository by `SGPstateData.R`.

## Usage

``` R
SGPstateData
```

## Format

An environment. Each program entry is a named list; entries are optional, and which ones are present depends on the program. Names that are used for merges are in ALL CAPS (content areas, `GRADE_3`); other names use `Camel_Case`.

`Assessment_Program_Information`

:   Names and abbreviations (`Assessment_Name`, `Assessment_Abbreviation`, `Organization`, `Test_Vendor`), `Content_Areas`, `Grades_Tested`, `Assessment_Years`, `Test_Season`, `CSEM` (conditional standard errors of measurement), and, where the assessment changed, `Assessment_Transition` and `Scale_Change`.

`Achievement`

:   `Cutscores` (by content area, or content area and year, then grade; each value is the *lower bound* of the next performance level), `Levels` (labels, and which levels count as proficient) and `Knots_Boundaries` (knots, boundaries and loss/hoss values by content area and grade).

`Growth`

:   `Levels`, `Cutscores` and `System_Type`, for programs that classify growth.

`SGP_Configuration`

:   Switches and functions that tailor an analysis, for example `sgp.cohort.size`, `grade.projection.sequence` and `sgp.loss.hoss.adjustment`.

`SGP_Norm_Group_Preference`, `SGP_Progression_Preference`

:   Which prior scores are used when more than one sequence is available.

`Student_Report_Information`

:   Labels, scale and reporting choices used by the student growth report generators.

`Custom_Student_Report`, `Variable_Name_Lookup`, `Baseline_splineMatrix`

:   Present for some programs only.

`digest`

:   A hash stamped on the object when it is built.

## Details

The object is a faithful record of each program's published cutscores and its configuration for SGP analyses. Do not edit entries to “fix” a result: the SGP package relies on the object exactly as built, and `scripts/check.R` in the repository fails when a build no longer reproduces the committed file.

## Source

The files in this repository: `Cutscores/`, `Knots_Boundaries/`, `CSEM/`, `Linkages/`, `Custom_SGP_Config/`, `Variable_Name_Lookup/` and the others read by `SGPstateData.R`. <https://github.com/CenterForAssessment/SGPstateData>

## See Also

<https://sgp.io> for the SGP package that embeds the object.

## Examples

``` R
## Not run: 
# From the SGP package:
library(SGP)
names(SGPstateData)[1:6]
SGPstateData[["GA"]][["Assessment_Program_Information"]][["Assessment_Name"]]
SGPstateData[["GA"]][["Achievement"]][["Levels"]][["Labels"]]
SGPstateData[["GA"]][["Achievement"]][["Cutscores"]][["MATHEMATICS"]][["GRADE_4"]]

## End(Not run)
```
